import pandas as pd
from sklearn.preprocessing import MinMaxScaler
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(data):
    scaler = MinMaxScaler()
    normalized = scaler.fit_transform(data)
    df = pd.DataFrame(normalized, columns=data.columns if hasattr(data, 'columns') else None, index=data.index if hasattr(data, 'index') else None)
    df['Average'] = df.mean(axis=1)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    df['Average'].plot(kind='bar', ax=ax)
    return df, ax
